subject: Venture Studio credits: options for transferring/promotional packaging
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@founderstudio.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership inquiry — transferring credits to venture studio portfolio

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Quick note from Founder Studio — we're launching a new venture studio cohort next month and would love to continue the conversation about Redwood partner incentives. Two specific questions:

1) Do you support a model where our studio is issued a pool of promotional credits that we can allocate to portfolio companies (i.e., we distribute vouchers internally), or do credits have to be issued directly to each company?

2) Are there packaging/expiration constraints we should be aware of (redemption windows, minimums per company, tax/invoicing requirements)?

We have 6 early-stage companies in this pilot cohort; if possible we'd prefer a simple path — either a small pool we can spend on behalf of companies or per-company vouchers we hand out. We're flexible on structure but want to understand what exceptions (if any) Redwood can make for partner programs.

Attaching a short partner overview and our expected cohort timeline. Happy to hop on a call to work through specifics.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | Founder Studio
[Attachment: FounderStudio_Partner_Overview.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@founderstudio.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — transferring credits to venture studio portfolio

Liam — thanks for the note and the overview (nice to meet you, Marissa copied). Short answers up front and then a practical set of options:

- We can support partner-led distribution in two flavors: 1) a managed pool (Redwood issues credits to your partner account and you redeem on behalf of portfolio companies), or 2) per-company vouchers we issue to each company email.

- Constraints: credits are typically time-bound (90 days standard), and we do have bookkeeping and audit controls that require us to tie usage to legal entities for compliance (especially for tax/invoice purposes). That drives our default toward per-company issuance, but managed pools are possible with a partner agreement and a brief compliance attestation.

Two pragmatic packaging options you might consider:

A) Partner Pool (simple admin)
  - Redwood issues a pool to Founder Studio; you request redemptions on a per-company basis via a partner portal or API.
  - Standard expiration: 90 days unless we build a program exception.
  - Minimum pool size historically: $5,000. We can consider a one-time exception for new partners.

B) Per-company Vouchers (clean compliance)
  - We issue unique voucher codes (or credits) tied to each company.
  - No minimum per voucher but operationally we recommend $1k+ for starter utility.

If you can share the cohort list and whether companies are already incorporated (or expected MVs), we can advise exact wording for invoicing and whether to allow pooled redemptions.

Happy to set up a 30-minute sync this week. I attached a short partner-terms draft to speed things up.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Partner_Program_Terms_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@founderstudio.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — transferring credits to venture studio portfolio

Hey Liam — thanks for the overview and timeline. A couple of practical suggestions based on similar studio partnerships we've run:

1) Pilot bundle (recommended)
  - Offer: Up to 8 vouchers, $5,000 each (consumable within 120 days), plus a $2,500 admin credit for program admin/support.
  - Why: Keeps accounting simple for the studio, gives each company meaningful runway to integrate and test Redwood, and gives Redwood consumption visibility.

2) Promotional pricing option (optional add-on)
  - If Founder Studio wants to guarantee a minimum commitment (e.g., 6 companies convert to paid plans within 6 months), we can extend a promotional tier: 25% off list for the first 6 months for those companies or a one-time 30% onboarding discount. This requires a brief SLA/commitment clause.

3) Exception path
  - We can waive the $5k pool minimum for early-stage partnerships, but we'd need a short partner exception form signed by your legal team and a one-off review by our finance team.

If the cohort includes pre-incorporated projects, we can issue vouchers to the studio to hold until incorporation (we'll need the expected legal names and tax IDs when they claim credits).

Next step: can you share the cohort spreadsheet (simple CSV) and a sense of which companies are already incorporated vs pre-incorporation? I'll draft a pilot term sheet after we see the list.

—Marissa
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Partner_Pilot_Example_Summary.xlsx (xlsx)]

Liam

Liam — good news: we can approve a limited early-partner waiver for Founder Studio for this pilot. Summary of agreed items and next steps below.

Agreed pilot terms (exception approved):
- Pilot: up to 6 vouchers (Founder Studio cohort), $5,000 each, consumable within 120 days from issuance.
- Admin credit: $2,500 applied to the studio partner account.
- Waiver: Redwood will waive the $5k pool minimum for this pilot only (exception documented); the waiver covers up to 4 pre-allocated redemptions you request on behalf of companies that are not yet incorporated.
- Pricing add-on: 25% promotional pricing for any companies that commit to a paid plan within 6 months — requires a signed pilot acceptance form.

Operational next steps:
1) I'll send a short Partner Pilot Acceptance (DocuSign link below). Please have your legal or operations sign to confirm the waiver and redemption process.
2) Once signed, we will issue voucher codes and provision the admin credit to your partner account. For any pre-incorporated companies you claim, we will hold the voucher and require legal name + tax ID when they claim.
3) Finance will need a PO or signed order form for internal bookkeeping; we'll accept a partner PO referencing deal FS-2027-041.
